prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1076; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. I can answer the questions though.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pearland, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space, slowly, and another car was coming down the main aisle.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?

A: Yes, I'd just started to back out. I was maybe going five miles an hour. The other vehicle hit the rear driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced in the mirror, but there were a lot of cars around and I didn't see it coming fast enough to react.

Q: Did you hit your head or have any injury at the scene?

A: My head hit the window frame pretty hard. I felt dizzy and had a headache right away. I sat in the car for a few minutes before I could get out.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon and they diagnosed a concussion. I've been told to rest, avoid screens for long periods, and not drive for a while.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes, I still get headaches, I'm sensitive to light, and I have trouble concentrating at work. Some days are better than others.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: I just want it on record that I was being careful and the other driver was going too fast for the lot. That's all I have.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
